name: Kalina Power Limited
summary: Kalina Power Limited operates as a power company in the United States, Australia, China, and the United Kingdom. It generates power primarily from waste heat, and geothermal and solar thermal sources using its Kalina Cycle technology. The company was formerly known as Enhanced Systems Technologies Limited and changed its name to Kalina Power Limited in June 2015. Kalina Power Limited is headquartered in Hawthorn, Australia.
